title: session.kill request

ownership_token.description: Opaque 256-bit conditional-cleanup token encoded as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. A managed wrapper may supply it at session.open and provide it to session.kill as an optional match precondition, not as authorization. When session.open omits it, the frontend binds a fail-closed internally generated token; never log or publish either form.

description: Force removal of a debug session.
x-how_it_works: 按 target.session_id 清理记录和关联资源；可选 ownership_token 提供时必须匹配，否则不执行，省略时保留既有显式/admin 清理语义。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: target.session_id；ownership_token 是 managed wrapper 的可选 conditional-cleanup precondition，不是授权

use_when: Know a stale or unhealthy session that cannot complete the graceful close lifecycle.
do_not_use_when: Do not use it for a healthy session that can be closed gracefully.

Do not treat args.ownership_token as authorization or dynamically require it for explicit administration; a managed wrapper supplies its own opaque key only as an ambiguous-open cleanup match precondition, and the key must never be invented, exposed, or logged.

alternatives.when: Release a healthy session through its normal lifecycle.

constraints: required: target.session_id；ownership_token 是 managed wrapper 的可选 conditional-cleanup precondition，不是授权
